text.description_html:
First Impressions Modern Square Stainless Steel Cabinet Pull

This very modern cabinet pull is made of 5/8" square solid stainless steel by First Impressions, a leader manufacture in door pulls. The Warm Satin Stainless Steel finish has a truly eye-catching, modern appearance. It requires little maintenance. Designed to enhance any setting where a modern, clean look is desired.

Also available: 18" Modern Square Stainless Refrigerator Pull and 24" Modern Square Stainless Refrigerator Pull

Specifications for First Impressions Modern Stainless Steel Cabinet Pull

  • Projection: 2-1/8"
  • Diameter: 5/8" Square
  • Material: Solid Stainless Steel
  • Finish: Satin Stainless Steel

Available in 2 Lengths

  • FII-SQDP/9-US32D :: Total Length - 9", Center to Center 6" C/C
  • FII-SQDP/12-US32D :: Total Length - 12", Center to Center 8" C/C

Note: The First Impressions pulls are handmade in the USA when you order it—allowing it to be custom designed to fit your specific door application, including different center to center mounting distances and Other Lengths. Unfortunately, because of the made-to-order nature of the door handle, it is Not Returnable. Please Contact Us with your requirements or if you have any questions.

Packaged with mounting screws for a standard 3/4" thick cabinet door panel or drawer.

*Sold individually.
